description: WalletGraph connects public entities, accounts, and onchain addresses when an authoritative source supports the relationship. Look up an exact address or account to see its relationship type, review date, and evidence URL. Coverage is limited to a small reviewed index of published protocol and token contracts. Empty results mean no reviewed mapping is in this index. WalletGraph does not infer personal wallet ownership, request API keys, access GMGN accounts, or execute trades.
